<quote by="Proposed: Necropolis, Seconded: Segura">To construct Spider's Dream Bridge with the additional 20 white granite fortification. Requesting funds.</quote>
==Overview==
* Repairs the damage done to the Spider's Dream Bridge as per the '''[[Dreaming in strands]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed at 240 thrones
* This motion was [[385YE_Winter_Solstice_Senate_sessions#Amend_Spider's_Dream_Construction|amended later]] in the season to remove the fortification
* 240 thrones disbursed to Senator for Necropolis. 
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 30 wains of mithril
* 10 wains of white granite
* 15 thrones in labour costs
* three months to construct
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Spider%27s_Dream_Bridge}}
==Outcome==
* Now that work is complete, Imperial armies can again march quickly from Sarvos and Tassato to Madruga and vice versa. In addition, the [[Spider's Tollkeep]] once again receives their seasonal income of two thrones.
